cod_collection_amount_check.name: cod_collection_amount_check
cod_collection_amount_check.value: "cod_collection_evidence"."amount_paise" > 0 AND length(trim("cod_collection_evidence"."receipt_reference")) BETWEEN 3 AND 120 AND length(trim("cod_collection_evidence"."idempotency_key")) BETWEEN 8 AND 160

inventory_adjustments_source_check.name: inventory_adjustments_source_check
inventory_adjustments_source_check.value: ("inventory_adjustments"."source_type" = 'manual' AND "inventory_adjustments"."source_id" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_adjustments"."source_type" = 'cycle_count' AND "inventory_adjustments"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)

manufacturer_canonical_state_merge_check.name: manufacturer_canonical_state_merge_check
manufacturer_canonical_state_merge_check.value: ("manufacturer_canonical_state"."status" = 'merged' AND "manufacturer_canonical_state"."merged_into_manufacturer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "manufacturer_canonical_state"."manufacturer_id" <> "manufacturer_canonical_state"."merged_into_manufacturer_id") OR ("manufacturer_canonical_state"."status" <> 'merged' AND "manufacturer_canonical_state"."merged_into_manufacturer_id" IS NULL)

manufacturer_change_requests_pair_check.name: manufacturer_change_requests_pair_check
manufacturer_change_requests_pair_check.value: "manufacturer_change_requests"."manufacturer_id" IS NULL OR "manufacturer_change_requests"."target_manufacturer_id" IS NULL OR "manufacturer_change_requests"."manufacturer_id" <> "manufacturer_change_requests"."target_manufacturer_id"

notifications_vendor_inventory_active_ui.name: notifications_vendor_inventory_active_uidx
notifications_vendor_inventory_active_ui.where: "notifications"."vendor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."notification_type" IN ('inventory_near_expiry', 'inventory_low_stock', 'inventory_zero_stock') AND "notifications"."lifecycle_status" <> 'resolved'

offline_sale_items_amount_check.name: offline_sale_items_amount_check
offline_sale_items_amount_check.value: "offline_sale_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."unit_price_paise" > 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."mrp_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."discount_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."taxable_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."tax_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."cgst_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."sgst_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."igst_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sale_items"."line_total_paise" >= 0

offline_sales_amounts_check.name: offline_sales_amounts_check
offline_sales_amounts_check.value: "offline_sales"."gross_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sales"."discount_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sales"."subtotal_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sales"."tax_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sales"."cgst_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sales"."sgst_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sales"."igst_paise" >= 0 AND "offline_sales"."total_paise" >= 0

tax_invoice_lines_amount_check.name: tax_invoice_lines_amount_check
tax_invoice_lines_amount_check.value: "tax_invoice_lines"."line_number" > 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."source_item_id" > 0 AND length(trim("tax_invoice_lines"."product_name")) > 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."quantity" > 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."unit_price_paise" > 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."gross_paise" = "tax_invoice_lines"."unit_price_paise" * "tax_invoice_lines"."quantity" AND "tax_invoice_lines"."discount_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."taxable_paise" = "tax_invoice_lines"."gross_paise" - "tax_invoice_lines"."discount_paise" AND "tax_invoice_lines"."taxable_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."gst_percent" IN (0, 5, 12, 18, 28) AND "tax_invoice_lines"."cgst_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."sgst_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."igst_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoice_lines"."line_total_paise" = "tax_invoice_lines"."taxable_paise" + "tax_invoice_lines"."cgst_paise" + "tax_invoice_lines"."sgst_paise" + "tax_invoice_lines"."igst_paise"

tax_invoices_identity_check.name: tax_invoices_identity_check
tax_invoices_identity_check.value: length(trim("tax_invoices"."invoice_number")) > 0 AND length(trim("tax_invoices"."seller_name")) > 0 AND length(trim("tax_invoices"."seller_address")) > 0 AND length(trim("tax_invoices"."buyer_name")) > 0 AND "tax_invoices"."place_of_supply_state_code" GLOB '[0-9][0-9]' AND "tax_invoices"."currency" = 'INR' AND "tax_invoices"."snapshot_version" = 1

tax_invoices_amount_check.name: tax_invoices_amount_check
tax_invoices_amount_check.value: "tax_invoices"."gross_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoices"."discount_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoices"."gross_paise" = "tax_invoices"."subtotal_paise" + "tax_invoices"."discount_paise" AND "tax_invoices"."subtotal_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoices"."cgst_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoices"."sgst_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoices"."igst_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoices"."delivery_fee_paise" >= 0 AND "tax_invoices"."total_paise" = "tax_invoices"."subtotal_paise" + "tax_invoices"."cgst_paise" + "tax_invoices"."sgst_paise" + "tax_invoices"."igst_paise" + "tax_invoices"."delivery_fee_paise"
